summary: Iteration 5 testing (backend + frontend) of digital membership card/public verify, Stripe program payments, and cascade chapter delete. Backend: 25 new pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_iter5_card_payments_cascade.py — all 25 passed (public verify valid/not_found/archived + sensitive-field exclusion, program fee persistence, 402 block on paid direct register, Stripe checkout URL/session_id + payment_transactions initiated/pending, free-program 400, unauth 401/403, unknown program 404, unknown session 404, chapter impact + RBAC 403/404, DELETE 409 payload, reassign_to migration of members/users/programs, force-orphan nulling chapter_id, reassign_to==self 400, reassign_to nonexistent 400, empty-chapter delete 200, non-national-admin 403, owner-admin email migration to hovsepmarachlian@gmail.com and old admin@scouts.am now rejected). Frontend: /verify/mbr_narek shows 'Active member' card with chapter/section/patrol; /verify/mbr_bogus shows 'Not a current member'; /members/mbr_narek/card renders membership-card with SVG QR pointing at /verify/mbr_narek and working print button; scout /programs shows 'Pay $30.00 & register' + $30.00 USD fee badge and clicking it redirects to https://checkout.stripe.com/c/pay/cs_test_...; /payment/cancel renders cancel card; /trash purge on a chapter with links opens cascade-dialog with counts (1 members/0 users/1 programs), target select, reassign and force buttons — force-orphan deleted the chapter and showed 'Chapter deleted (records orphaned)'. No blocking defects found.

minor.issue: Unknown session returns 404 which the frontend treats as a transient error and polls 12x2s (~24s) before showing a state; consider a distinct 'not_found' response so the UI can fail fast.
Members are only archived (soft delete) with no hard-purge route, so test/orphan member rows accumulate in Trash (6 archived members currently). Not new to iteration 5.

ui_bugs.issue: Demo credential line still reads 'admin@scouts.am / admin123' but that account was renamed to hovsepmarachlian@gmail.com and now returns 401 — misleading for users/testers.

Hard-error/timeout state uses a spinner icon and copy 'Still processing…' even when the session id is bogus (status 404 forever); a real failure state (XCircle + 'We couldn't find this payment') would be clearer. Takes ~24s to appear.

issues: Program cards showed empty time/location placeholders ('–' and blank pin) for programs created without those fields — consider hiding empty rows
Before cleanup the list was polluted with 16 leftover TEST_Program artifacts from previous iterations (now purged by this agent)

Optional: differentiate 'transaction not found' from transient polling errors on /payment/success so the UI shows a real failure state quickly.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1985 lines — split into routers (chapters/members/programs/admin) per the 700-line guideline.
payments.py get_payment_status swallows all Stripe exceptions with a bare `except Exception: pass` — log the error so webhook-fallback failures are diagnosable.

DELETE /api/chapters cascade performs 4 sequential update/delete operations without a transaction; a mid-way failure leaves records reassigned but the chapter alive. Consider ordering deletion last (already the case) and logging partial state.
POST /api/payments/programs/checkout trusts client-supplied origin_url for success/cancel URLs; validate it against an allow-list to avoid open-redirect style abuse.
